Anil Rai Gupta:  
Thank you, Tanay. Good evening, and thank you for attending the call today. Hope you would 
have reviewed the results by now. 
We delivered a strong performance in the second quarter, with revenue growing 35% year-on-
year. During the quarter, each of our categories grew, with healthy contributions from both our 
established categories, including cables and switchgear, as well as the emerging renewables 
category. 
 
Encouragingly, the consumer demand remains steady despite the inflationary environment. 
During the quarter, we also undertook calibrated pricing actions in response to the sharp rise in 
raw material costs witnessed over the past several months. 
 
Contribution margins were softer year-on-year, primarily due to cables, where a decline in 
aluminium prices during the quarter impacted margins, particularly against a strong base last 
year. For H1, cables contribution margins were approximately 15%, broadly in line with the 
long-term average. In the rest of the portfolio, margins held up well, supported by pricing actions 
that helped offset raw material inflation. 
 
Lloyd also delivered healthy revenue growth, supported by both volume and value growth. 
Margins, however, remained subdued with raw material inflation, as well as seasonal under-
absorption during the off-season. 
 
At an overall level, operating leverage supported healthy EBITDA growth of approximately 
30%. PBT growth was relatively moderate, primarily due to the higher base arising from a one-
time gain in other income in the corresponding period last year. 
 
Looking ahead, while macroeconomic uncertainties persist and commodity prices remain 
elevated, we enter the festive season with a positive outlook on both demand and margins. With

kicking in. So, I think this will start in the third quarter and will trickle into the fourth quarter as 
well.
